_about: Alias registry read by skills and agents. Deliberately not named .mcp.json: Claude Code loads a plugin's root .mcp.json as MCP server config. Actual server wiring example: .mcp.json.example.

portfolio.resolution: Bound whenever a broker connector with these read tools is available in the session (e.g. Montrose or IBKR added as a connector). There is no fixed tool name to configure.
portfolio.purpose: Read-only portfolio state: accounts, holdings, cost basis, cash per currency, and watchlists. Replaces pasting the portfolio in by hand. Read by the /analyze orchestrator only.
portfolio.fallback: If no broker connector is available or it fails, use the portfolio the user provides and say so in the report. Downstream agents receive the portfolio JSON and its `source` field — they do not check this registry to decide whether a broker was used.
portfolio.block_write_tools_in_client: Set every write/delete tool of the broker connector to never allowed in the client's tool permissions (e.g. claude.ai connector settings). Set the read tools above to always allowed so scheduled runs are not blocked by approval prompts.

quotes.purpose: Authoritative current price, prior close and day change, with timestamp and currency. Up to 20 symbols per call.

history.purpose: Raw OHLCV bars for support/resistance, drawdown, event-day price moves and period returns. Max 400 most recent bars.

indicators.purpose: Computed SMA 20/50/200, RSI(14), MACD(12,26,9), 52-week/20-day ranges and volume ratios from ~2 years of daily bars. Up to 10 symbols per call.

fx.purpose: ECB reference rates for every currency conversion, latest or on a given date.

rates.purpose: Riksbank, ECB and Fed policy rates, last changes (effective dates) and a data-derived stance from official feeds: Riksbank SWEA API, ECB Data Portal, NY Fed Markets API.

regime.purpose: Market regime (RISK-ON / TRANSITIONAL / RISK-OFF) in one call: index trend, VIX, European sector returns and central-bank stance fetched server-side, the market-snapshot signal matrix applied in code, plus an advisory TypeSafe Jev opinion with per-regime probabilities.

research.purpose: Qualitative and fundamental data no structured tool provides: fundamentals and ratios, analyst ratings and targets, earnings dates, estimates and results, guidance, Fed stance, catalysts, fund facts. Output from it must be labelled search-derived.

notifications.purpose: Optional progress updates and final report delivery, sent only by the /analyze orchestrator. Set NOTIFICATION_MCP_TOOL to your provider's tool name (e.g. mcp__slack__slack_post_message).
notifications.enabled_when: NOTIFICATION_MCP_TOOL is set and that tool is available in the session; otherwise notifications are skipped and results are returned in the response.

tool_name_resolution: MCP tools appear with a client-specific prefix (Claude Code: mcp__<server>__<tool>; claude.ai/Cowork connectors use the connector name). Resolve an alias by its tool name suffix.
rules: Any figure quotes, history, indicators, fx, rates or regime can produce must come from those tools — never from search results or hand calculation
Use research (WebSearch/WebFetch) only for data no structured tool provides, and label it search-derived
Never call write tools on the portfolio connector (orders, trade tickets, alerts, watchlist edits)
Do not hardcode model names in skills or commands — use connector aliases only
Only the /analyze orchestrator reads the portfolio connector and sends notifications — every subagent is read-only
